headline: Executive order launches a federal effort to speed up improvements in HIV prevention and care across the United States.
what_it_does: This order creates the HIV Care Continuum Initiative. Based on its title, it directs the federal government to speed up work on preventing HIV and improving care for people living with HIV. No summary was provided, so specific agency duties, deadlines, or funding details are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at improving the care and services available to them.

who_it_affects.group: People at risk of getting HIV
who_it_affects.how: The order focuses on improving HIV prevention efforts that may reach them.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run health programs
who_it_affects.how: They are likely to be directed to carry out or support the initiative.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 15, 2013; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
